name: Console CodePage Lookup Via CHCP
description: Detects use of chcp to look up the system locale value as part of host discovery
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: During Anaconda update the 'conda.exe' process will eventually execution the 'chcp' command.
Discord was seen using chcp to look up code pages
query: process.parent.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND (process.parent.command_line:(*\ \-c\ * OR *\ \/c\ * OR *\ –c\ * OR *\ —c\ * OR *\ ―c\ *) OR process.parent.command_line:(*\ \-r\ * OR *\ \/r\ * OR *\ –r\ * OR *\ —r\ * OR *\ ―r\ *) OR process.parent.command_line:(*\ \-k\ * OR *\ \/k\ * OR *\ –k\ * OR *\ —k\ * OR *\ ―k\ *)) AND process.executable:*\\chcp.com AND (process.command_line:(*chcp OR *chcp\  OR *chcp\ \ ))
